key_gap: vs baseline: the pure MECE baseline and the non-routed v5 AI reached the same destination (promos −2.2 / mix −1.6 / freight −1.1 / COGS −0.8 / returns −0.7 / fees −0.6 = −7.0; ranking by impact x controllability x testability; 8-week matched-product promo hold-out as H1), but the baseline opened with the margin identity and built the MECE tree first-pass with mix as its own branch, while the v5 AI rebuilt the tree across two WHY passes and self-corrected a promo x mix double-count (−2.6/−1.2) only because the sum-to-−7.0 check caught it. The v6 routed run executed the identity-first MECE tree as the m068 completion contract in a single first-class pass — no re-walk, no double-count — and added P1 provenance (no anchors; CFO ask is a prior, not evidence), P3 failure branches (hold-out falsified -> freight-first fallback), and two S2 insights the baseline lacks (residual-as-tree-error; promo x mix causal entanglement requiring mix-constant attribution AND measurement).
learning_signal: On KPI-attribution signatures (estimate/maximize/predict with a defining identity and complete data), routing the MECE module first-class with its completion contract converts a recovered answer into a one-pass answer: emit the defining identity as the frame (Margin = Revenue − COGS − Freight − Returns − Fees; Revenue = Price x Volume x Mix), build the tree MECE from it with mix as its own branch (the classic miss), attribute every branch holding the others constant (no double-count), require sum-of-branches = observed change before leaving WHY (open residual triggers the missing-branch hunt, not noise-logging), prioritize by expected impact x controllability x testability rather than size, state H1 falsifiably with a test design and success metric, and apply a premature-pruning guard (a large-but-structural branch is held until tested, never discarded).
suggested_improvement: Keep the m068 contract's tree-first discipline with the close-the-arithmetic gate as the completeness check (promo depth attributed with mix held constant); add the promo x mix entanglement flag (attribute AND measure mix-constant) as a standing S2 insight on retail/commerce attribution books; retain P3 failure-branch pricing (falsified hold-out -> next-branch sequence) and the premature-pruning guard as mandatory contract items so a data-complete attribution problem can never degrade into a multi-pass reconstruction.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style's registered weaknesses (tree too rigid, premature pruning) operated exactly as documented — the baseline built the tree from the supplied branches, force-fit the 18pt unexplained residual to the Q3 rebates restatement ('measurement noise'), pruned the renegotiated top-account program as immaterial-to-averages (8% of category revenue), and recommended freight/COGS cost-cutting, attacking the ~1pt explained branch while the verified root cause sat in the packet. The non-routed v5 AI already won via residual-as-completeness-alarm; the v6 routed run made that win structural: the P1 provenance audit flagged the finance note as an interested-party framing and falsified it by construction (a timing restatement nets to ~0 P&L and cannot be a 12-month leak), the residual gate (>10% of the change forces a missing-branch hunt before pruning) fired before the m044 first-class pass concluded, the m011 loop scan surfaced the auto-extension reinforcing loop, and the mandatory m019 adversary pass priced the averages-mask-bimodality and 'actionable-branch' vectors with quantified exposure (18 of 19pts misattributed).
learning_signal: The tree is a hypothesis about the structure of the problem, not the problem itself: when branch attribution does not sum to the observed change, the tree is incomplete, not the data noisy. On diagnosis signatures with an open residual, run the reconciliation BEFORE any prioritization or pruning — residual > ~10% of the change forces a missing-branch hunt and account/product-level disaggregation (averages mask bimodal distributions); verify any 'one-time/noise' explanation against its construction (an accounting timing item cannot be a 12-month margin leak) and against who benefits from the framing (P1 interested-party audit); pair the residual gate with a stakeholder pass (who owns the missing line, who priced the deal) and an adversary pass on adversarial contexts — the pure style's pruning instinct is exactly the vector that converts the packet's decoy into the wrong recommendation.
suggested_improvement: Stand up the residual-reconciliation + interested-party pair as mandatory on adversarial diagnosis signatures (this route: m044 first-class, m011/m070 context, m019 gate): (a) after attribution, compute the open residual explicitly; (b) residual > ~10% of the change -> missing-branch hunt + disaggregation before prioritization/pruning; (c) falsify 'noise' explanations by construction and provenance (who benefits); (d) let the stakeholder pass surface the missing line (terms/programs nobody owns on the P&L); (e) log the residual's verified disposition in the packet so the trap can never be re-introduced by a single-route rerun.
